structure: Part 10 read COVERAGE.md in full (header, the generated Routes table of 77 GET routes under /design-release-2.1, the 39-row DR2.1 override views table, 'Not reached, and why' with 9 items, and 'Behaviour worth knowing' with 19 numbered items), README.md in full (run instructions, outputs, layout, prototype gotchas), playwright.config.js and e2e/support/evidence.js. Claims cover: the suite's baseline (prototype commit, 156 passing tests); one claim per route row (route, view, override or shared, visited or not); one claim per override-view row; one gap per unreached route or behaviour with its reason; one or more claims per numbered behaviour item (13 marked observed, not asserted); the README gotchas that describe prototype behaviour (arrival date window, bespoke autocompletes, species checkboxes, MOJ date picker, session racing, dev mode); and the suite set-up that bounds what it can reach (one worker, chromium at 1280x1200, trace and video on every test, evidence slugs). Spec behaviour behind each route is claimed by the spec parts.

Not reached: the permanent-address override page. GET and POST /permanent-address both reset the answer and redirect to /permanent-address/select, and /permanent-address/enter-address redirects there too, so the view is dead in DR2.1.
claims.quote:
`renderPermanentAddressPage` is never
  called. `GET` and `POST /permanent-address` both reset the answer and redirect
  to `/permanent-address/select` (the per-animal page), and
  `/permanent-address/enter-address` redirects there too. Dead view in DR2.1.
claims.note: mechanism: the permanent-address answer is reset on every visit to /permanent-address.

claims.statement: Not reached: the contact-address-for-consignment override page. GET and POST /contact-address-for-consignment redirect a DR2.1 session to /review-notification, and the hub and review no longer list a contact address, so the view is dead in DR2.1.

`GET` and `POST
  /contact-address-for-consignment` redirect a DR2.1 session to
  `/review-notification`, and the hub and review no longer list a contact
  address. Dead view in DR2.1.

claims.statement: Not reached as a page: POST /upload-documents/virus-check/:documentId is a JSON endpoint; its client script posts to the unprefixed path, so under DR2.1 it never marks the DR2.1 document as passed (this is asserted).
claims.quote:
a JSON endpoint, not a
  page. The client script posts to the *unprefixed* path, so under DR2.1 it hits
  the root session and never marks the DR2.1 document as passed (asserted in
  `documents` › "a complete document is listed…").
claims.note: A prototype mount defect, not intended behaviour.

only renders with an address
  pending from a usage category; in DR2.1 the uses are chosen on the details
  page itself, so the route only ever redirects (to `/address-book/add`). The
  redirect is covered; the page is not.

consignee, importer and place of destination add a new
   address through a UK postcode lookup (find, select, then a prefilled details
   form)

claims.statement: Place of origin and consignor add a new address through a manual form.
claims.quote: place of origin and consignor use a manual form.

claims.statement: Each chosen address on the roles page has a Remove button.
claims.quote:
Each chosen address
   has a Remove button.

claims.statement: There is no contact address step: the roles page continues to the review.
claims.quote:
There is no contact address step: the roles page
   continues to the review.

claims.statement: Once chosen, the transporter is shown on its own with Change and Remove.
claims.quote:
once chosen, the transporter is shown on its own with
   Change and Remove.

claims.statement: Adding a private transporter asks a name and a UK postcode, then an address from the list, then contact details, with an "Enter address manually" alternative.
claims.quote:
Adding a private transporter asks a name and a UK
   postcode, then an address from the list, then contact details (or "Enter
   address manually").

claims.statement: Adding a commercial transporter asks the authorisation number first, then a postcode (example BT1 5GS) or a manual entry fixed to Northern Ireland.
claims.quote:
A commercial transporter asks the authorisation number
   first, then a postcode (example BT1 5GS) or manual entry fixed to Northern
   Ireland.

claims.statement: Remove on a document opens a "Delete this document?" page.
claims.quote: **Documents:** Remove opens a "Delete this document?" page.

claims.statement: For a submitted notification, the review's Actions menu offers Amend, Make template, Copy as new and Delete.
claims.quote:
the review's Actions menu offers Amend, Make
    template, Copy as new and Delete for a submitted notification.

claims.statement: Amend asks for confirmation first.

Amending a seeded notification is silently blocked: its arrival date and port ("London Heathrow", where the arrival page saves "London Heathrow - LHR") are not in the saved formats, so Continue on the amend review stays put with no error until both are re-entered.
claims.quote:
**Amending a seeded notification is silently blocked**: its arrival date
    and its port ("London Heathrow", where the arrival page saves "London
    Heathrow - LHR") are not in the formats the arrival page saves, so
    "Continue" on the amend review stays put with no error until both are
    re-entered.
claims.note: A prototype seed-data defect, not intended behaviour.

claims.statement: The arrival page saves the port as "<name> - <code>", such as "London Heathrow - LHR".
claims.quote:
where the arrival page saves "London
    Heathrow - LHR"

claims.statement: Mount leak: the transporter list's View details links go to unprefixed /address-book/… paths outside the DR2.1 mount.
claims.quote:
**Mount leaks:** the transporter list's "View details" links and the virus
    check go to unprefixed `/address-book/…` and `/upload-documents/…` paths.
claims.note: A prototype mount defect, not intended behaviour.

claims.statement: Mount leak: the document virus check goes to an unprefixed /upload-documents/… path outside the DR2.1 mount.
claims.quote:
**Mount leaks:** the transporter list's "View details" links and the virus
    check go to unprefixed `/address-book/…` and `/upload-documents/…` paths.
claims.note: A prototype mount defect, not intended behaviour.

claims.statement: The germinal amend example GBN-GP-26-7K8M3H opens in amend with live cattle answers (Bison bison). Observed only, not asserted by any spec.
claims.quote:
**The germinal amend example** (`GBN-GP-26-7K8M3H`) opens in amend with live
    cattle answers (Bison bison). Observed, not asserted.
claims.note: Marked 'Observed, not asserted' in the source, so no spec proves it; likely a seed-data defect.

claims.statement: Cancel on Add a private transporter ("Cancel and return to dashboard") leaves the journey for the overall dashboard.
claims.quote:
**Cancel on "Add a private transporter"** ("Cancel and return to dashboard")
    leaves the journey for the overall dashboard.

claims.statement: Deleting a notification lands on the overall dashboard, which shows no banner.
claims.quote:
**Delete notification** lands on the overall dashboard, which shows no
    banner;

claims.statement: The "… has been deleted" banner for a deleted notification appears on the category dashboard.
claims.quote: the "… has been deleted" banner appears on the category dashboard.

claims.statement: On the roles page, a "Same as place of origin" button appears for the consignor once place of origin is filled.
claims.quote:
"Same as place of origin" (consignor) and "Same as
    consignee" (importer, place of destination) buttons appear once the source
    role is filled.

claims.statement: On the roles page, "Same as consignee" buttons appear for the importer and place of destination once the consignee is filled.
claims.quote:
"Same as place of origin" (consignor) and "Same as
    consignee" (importer, place of destination) buttons appear once the source
    role is filled.

claims.statement: The address book is shared across design releases, through the session keys addressBookAddedAddresses and submittedNotifications.
claims.quote:
**Address book** is shared across releases (session keys
    `addressBookAddedAddresses`, `submittedNotifications`)
claims.note: mechanism: prototype session storage of address book entries and submitted notifications.

claims.statement: Address book success banners use sentence case, such as "Green valley farm address deleted".
claims.quote:
success banners use
    sentence case ("Green valley farm address deleted").

claims.statement: Create new template asks the type, then the name, then runs the journey in template mode.
claims.quote:
"Create new template" asks the type, then the name, then runs
    the journey in template mode

claims.statement: Template mode has no documents section and no declaration; those routes redirect.
claims.quote:
(no documents section, no declaration; those
    routes redirect).

claims.statement: An unnamed template saves as "Untitled template".
claims.quote: An unnamed template saves as "Untitled template".

claims.statement: Changing one section of a saved template offers only "Save and return", then shows a banner "<name> has been updated".
claims.quote:
Changing
    one section of a saved template offers only "Save and return" and a banner
    "<name> has been updated".

claims.statement: Fifteen templates are seeded, live animals and germinal products.
claims.quote: Fifteen templates are seeded, live and germinal.

claims.statement: On the overall dashboard, the plants card, View requirements and Manage account links are # placeholders.
claims.quote:
**Overall dashboard** plants card, "View requirements" and "Manage account"
    links are `#` placeholders.

claims.statement: Arrival dates count as complete only within 7 days back to 6 months ahead of today.
claims.quote:
Arrival dates are only "complete" within 7 days back to 6 months ahead, so the
  suite uses dates relative to today.

claims.statement: Country, port and transit-country fields are bespoke autocompletes: the user types, then picks an option from a list.
claims.quote:
Country, port and transit-country fields are bespoke autocompletes: type per
  key, then click `button.app-country-search__option`.

claims.statement: Species are chosen with checkboxes, which set a hidden selectedSpecies value before the user continues.
claims.quote:
Species are checkboxes `#commodity-species-<id>`; wait for the hidden
  `selectedSpecies` value before continuing.
claims.note: mechanism: hidden selectedSpecies field mirrors the species checkboxes.

claims.statement: Date fields use MOJ date pickers, dismissed with Escape after typing.
claims.quote: MOJ date pickers are dismissed with Escape after typing.

claims.statement: The prototype runs in dev mode only for the suite; its serve mode forces https and secure cookies.
claims.quote: Dev mode only; `serve` forces https and secure cookies.

claims.statement: The suite runs with one worker because the prototype kit races journey session state across concurrent requests.
claims.quote: One worker: the kit races session state across concurrent requests.

claims.statement: The suite boots the prototype on port 3010 by default (overridable with PROTOTYPE_DIR and PROTOTYPE_PORT), waits on the TCP port and reuses a running server outside CI.
claims.quote:
in dev mode on port 3010 (Playwright `webServer`, waits on the TCP port, reuses a
server already on that port outside CI), runs the suite with one worker

claims.statement: Every test runs in Desktop Chrome (chromium) at a 1280x1200 viewport, with no retries, a 180 second test timeout and a 10 second expect timeout.
Every test records a trace, a video and screenshots, pass or fail, because the traces are requirement sources for the DR2.1 distil.
claims.quote:
video: { mode: 'on', size: { width: 1280, height: 1200 } },
    trace: 'on',
    screenshot: 'on'

claims.statement: The suite writes one trace zip per test to ../sources/traces-prototype/ with an index of file, spec, test, status and the pages visited, where pages lists every main-frame document request in order, POSTs and redirect hops included.
claims.quote:
`pages` lists every main-frame document request in order, including POSTs and
redirect hops.

claims.statement: Evidence screenshots are full-page, one per page state, named <page-slug>[--<state>].png, where the page slug is the URL path with /design-release-2.1 removed and 'dashboard' for the mount root; the first test to reach a state owns its screenshot.
claims.quote: // One screenshot per page state per run: the first test to reach a state owns it.

claims.statement: Each evidence record holds the slug, URL with query, the page's first h1 heading, the state, the file, the spec and the test.
claims.quote: Evidence index `{slug, url, heading, state, file, spec, test}`

claims.statement: The specs are organised one per feature area: dashboards, section 1 (type, origin, commodity, reason), section 2 (commodity, identification, additional details), transport and arrival, documents, consignment parties and contact, end-to-end journeys with the hub, review and declaration, managing notifications, templates and address book.
claims.quote:
one spec per feature area: dashboards, section 1 (type,
  origin, commodity, reason), section 2 (commodity, identification, additional
  details), transport and arrival, documents, consignment parties and contact,
  end-to-end journeys plus the hub/review/declaration, managing notifications,
  templates, address book.

claims.statement: The route table's 'Visited by' counts every test whose trace requested the route, redirect hops included, and is generated from the trace and evidence indexes by npm run coverage.
claims.quote:
The route table below is generated from
`../sources/traces-prototype/index.json` and `../evidence/prototype/index.json`
by `npm run coverage`; "Visited by" counts every test whose trace requested the
route (redirect hops included).
